verdict.rationale: Aider's documented non-interactive features do not amount to setting up autonomous background automations. `--message` and `coder.run` execute one instruction and then exit. That is a one-off action, not a recurring or scheduled automation, and the Python scripting API is officially unsupported. `--watch-files` only reacts to AI comments the user writes by hand, which makes it an adjacent editor-trigger feature. The 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a third-party community add-on, not part of the product. Any scheduling would have to be a user-side workaround such as cron, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
